operation.summary: An already authorized Super agent replaces grants or changes roles for an existing paired control agent, including its own configuration bootstrap; applets, portals and device peers excluded

body.name: expected_generation
body.description: Exact opaque generation from access discovery; changes on key rotation

body.name: capabilities
body.description: Replace legacy capability ids; null allows all (relay stores explicit ids)

body.name: control_scopes
body.description: Replace control grants with these known scopes, durable until revoked; [] clears; native capture revocation also narrows corresponding legacy permissions

body.name: super_powers
body.description: Delegate/revoke Super Powers; caller must already have them

body.name: maximum_control
body.description: Preserves the separate Superpowers role. true alone grants native maximum capabilities/roles/scopes; false stops future maximum inheritance

operation.returns: sanitized control-agent access,approval_required=false; no key creation or Android consent bypass
